paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical performances of NiCoFeAlTi high-entropy intermetallic reinforced CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy composites manufactured by selective laser melting
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

The CoCrFeMnNi HEA powder (matrix phase), was gas atomized by Jiangsu Valary Company.
The NiCoFeAlTi high-entropy intermetallic reinforcement (HER) powder was prepared by Zhongyuan New Materials Company.

The CoCrFeMnNi HEA and NiCoFeAlTi HER powders were uniformly mixed using a 3D motion mixer according to the proportions specified in Table 1. The mixing parameters are as follows: rotation speed (R) - 40 rpm and milling time - 2 h.

The SLM process was conducted under a high-purity argon protective atmosphere with 316L substrate. The printing parameters were as follows: laser power (P) - 160 W, scanning speed (V) - 1200 mm/min, layer thickness (t) - 30 μm, and hatch spacing (h) - 50 μm. A hatch style rotation of 67° was employed between adjacent layers during the printing process.
